  - comment: Finance lookup confirms Matthew Mejia (E034) is an Analyst. HR/IT report full-time employment.   - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1, note 2, note 3)

  - comment: Compliance lookup confirms Matthew Mejia (E034) is an Analyst. HR/IT/Finance report full-time employment. As a full-time Analyst, max access to Payroll is write (admin requires the owning role, Payroll Specialist; Analyst does not own Payroll). Requested write equals the maximum, so recommend write.
Note 5 (ticket 1):

  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1, note 2, note 3, note 4)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Facilities lookup confirms Matthew Mejia (E034) is an Analyst. HR reports full-time employment. As a full-time Analyst, max access to Payroll is write (admin requires the owning role, Payroll Specialist; Analyst does not own Payroll). Requested write equals the maximum, so recommend write.
Note 6 (ticket 1):

  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB lookup for Matthew Mejia (E034) shows contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training — never admin. With basic training, max access is read. Requested write exceeds max, so recommend read.
reason: Requested: write to Payroll. HR's note (copied by IT/Finance/Compliance/Facilities, who did not independently verify employment type) says full-time Analyst, but Security's own database lookup independently verifies Matthew Mejia (E034) as a contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors may have read, or write only with advanced security training (never admin). With basic training, the maximum is read. Since requested write exceeds the maximum, grant the maximum: read.

Note 6 (Security): says contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training, never admin. With basic training, max is read. Requested write exceeds max, recommend read.

Security note says "Security DB lookup for Matthew Mejia (E034) shows contractor with basic security training." That's the Security database, which may be the authoritative source for employment type? The notes say different agents looked up in own database. HR looked up employment type in own database.
